review.text: Sean and his team responded during an epic winter storm, while he was on vacation, and deployed his crew and got to work! The entire team is thoughtful, professional, and does exceptional work. Months later we needed a new roof vent installed and Sean and his team took care of it within 24 hours. The venting was time sensitive and unplanned, and Sean and the team made us a priority. It’s just one more example of a roofing company that is responsive, professional, and does the job right standing behind their work!
